doc: A Tab Bar is a UI component used in mobile and web applications to provide easy navigation between different sections or views of an app. It typically appears at the bottom of the screen on mobile devices and contains multiple tabs, each representing a different section of the app. Users can tap on these tabs to switch between sections quickly. The Tab Bar helps improve user experience by making navigation intuitive and efficient.
